selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with required SSH public key installed
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed opsadmin absent; user was created and authorized_keys populated with exactly the required ed25519 key, verified with correct ownership/permissions (600 file, 700 dir) and single-line content.

selected_evidence.requirement: SSH configured to require key-based authentication (password auth disabled)
selected_evidence.summary: Found a conflicting duplicate directive causing password auth to remain effectively enabled despite an existing trailing 'no' line (OpenSSH first-match-wins); fixed the first occurrence, validated with sshd -t, reloaded, and confirmed via sshd -T that passwordauthentication=[REDACTED]] and pubkeyauthentication=yes cluster-wide.

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof key-based login works and password login is rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Live SSH session as opsadmin succeeded using a public-key credential; a login attempt with pubkey auth disabled was rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey,...)', confirming enforcement end-to-end pre-restart.
Captured boot_id (151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a), uptime, sshd active status, opsadmin identity, and effective sshd auth config before reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgment and changed boot identity for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged via connection drop; node was unreachable during restart; reconnection showed a new boot_id (1b3203e5-a54b-462c-a222-2fcbffec32c2) and fresh uptime timestamp, proving an actual OS restart rather than a service bounce.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of services, account, and SSH policy on node1
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, sshd was active, opsadmin still existed with its home/.ssh intact, authorized_keys retained the required key, and sshd -T still reported password auth disabled/pubkey enabled; a live SSH functional retest confirmed pubkey login success and password login refusal, then test artifacts were cleaned up leaving only the required key.
